title: Electrolytes that mind bridging the gap
abstract: Published online: 20 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41557-026-02287-3 Silicon anodes enable high-energy-density Li-ion batteries but face reversibility challenges when operating under extreme temperature and charge-rate conditions. Now, a liquid electrolyte design results in interface protection and reduced electrode expansion during such operation, while also having <mark>lithium</mark> plating tolerance.

title: Directed assembly of cathode interlayers enables efficient binary organic solar cells
abstract: Published online: 20 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41560-026-02148-w Cathode interlayers play a pivotal role in improving the performance of organic solar cells. Yao, Zhang, Zhang, Wang et al. show a stepwise solvent treatment to achieve a vertically aligned cathode interlayer, enabling a certified efficiency of 20.65% in binary organic solar cells.
